security_audit.summary: Of 40 static findings, 38 are false positives involving Markdown, Chinese text, official links, credential configuration, or creator identifiers. Two command examples execute an unpinned npm package with automatic installation, creating dependency risk in an environment containing the API key. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or concealed payloads in the two reviewed files; external package implementation was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package integrity, and obtain installation approval before execution in an environment containing SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY.

content.value_statement: Creator quotes and audience metrics can be difficult to compare against a campaign budget. This skill guides evidence-based candidate comparisons using SocialDataX commercial data.
actual_capabilities: Guide queries for creator quotes, audience profiles, and content performance through SocialDataX CLI or corresponding MCP tools.
Resolve supplied creator profile URLs into user IDs before requesting commercial data.
Compare candidate quotes, audience evidence, content metrics, budget fit, and missing information.
Estimate query credits before execution and select only the endpoints needed for the evaluation.
Keep cooperation-note comparisons within matching scopes and report service-provided data windows.
Separate returned facts from recommendations and preserve available evidence links.
limitations: Live queries require a SocialDataX API key, available credits, network access, and a working CLI or configured MCP tools.
Only supplied candidates are evaluated; the workflow does not discover additional creators.
Commercial data may be unavailable or incomplete, and performance windows cannot use arbitrary start and end dates.
The skill cannot predict sales, calculate actual ROI, confirm negotiated prices, contact creators, or execute agreements.

use_cases.title: Screen Candidates Against a Brand Budget
use_cases.description: Compare supplied creator quotes with a product campaign budget before requesting additional commercial data.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Evidence-Based Client Shortlist
use_cases.description: Compare audience fit and cooperation-note performance for client-approved candidates while recording missing information.

use_cases.title: Review Partnership Research Quality
use_cases.description: Check data windows, missing metrics, quote assumptions, and supporting links before stakeholders approve creator outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Candidate Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [candidate IDs or profiles] for [product] targeting [audience] with a budget of [amount and currency]. Ask for essential missing information before querying.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: define the campaign and candidate list.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Quote-Only Budget Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Screen [candidate IDs] against [budget and currency] using quote data only. State expected credits and obtain approval before querying. Flag missing and zero quotes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: minimize query scope for an initial budget decision.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Audience and Content Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [candidate IDs] for [product and target audience] within [budget]. Propose quote, audience, and cooperation-performance queries with estimated credits before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine audience evidence with commercial content performance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Partially Completed Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [existing results] for [campaign requirements]. Check data windows, note scopes, evidence links, and missing fields. Separate facts from recommendations. Propose only necessary additional queries for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: reconcile incomplete evidence without duplicating queries.

output_examples.input: Plan queries for three supplied candidates using quotes, audience profiles, and content performance.
output: Planned scope: three commercial endpoints per candidate, for nine successful queries.
Estimated charge: 180 credits if every query succeeds, based on the documented rate of 20 credits per successful commercial query.
Profile URL resolution, if needed, has a separate command fee.
Awaiting approval before querying; no candidate data has been retrieved.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied results: Candidate A has a zero quote and incomplete audience data; Candidate B has unavailable commercial data.
output: Candidate A: needs more information. A zero quote does not establish free collaboration, and incomplete audience data prevents a supported fit conclusion.
Candidate B: commercial data unavailable. Preserve existing results and do not retry with alternate identifiers.
Budget fit remains unconfirmed. No sales forecast or actual ROI calculation is supported by these results.

best_practices: Confirm candidate identifiers, selected endpoints, and expected query credits before requesting commercial data.
Compare matching note scopes and returned time windows, and label missing data explicitly.
Review and pin the CLI package before execution, and keep the provider API key out of reports and shared outputs.
anti_patterns: Query every commercial endpoint or expand the candidate list without a clear need and approved scope.
Treat zero quotes as free offers, fill missing metrics with zeros, or combine medians.
Present estimated costs as actual ROI or promise sales from creator performance metrics.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The package lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Live queries also require authorized access to the documented CLI or corresponding MCP tools.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the brand or product, target audience, campaign budget, and candidate creator IDs or profile URLs.

faq.question: How much do commercial queries cost?
faq.answer: The skill documents 20 credits per successful commercial endpoint query, with no charge for failures. Profile URL resolution has separate command pricing.

faq.question: Can I select any performance date range?
faq.answer: No. Performance and trend queries use service-defined windows. Comparisons should retain the returned dates and matching note scopes.

faq.question: Can the skill predict ROI or arrange a partnership?
faq.answer: No. It compares available evidence and budget fit. It does not predict sales, calculate actual ROI, contact creators, or sign agreements.

faq.question: What should I check before running the CLI?
faq.answer: Review and pin the npm package rather than automatically executing latest. Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY securely and approve query costs before requesting data.
